title: Nonabelian Lattice Weak Gravity Conjecture and Monopole Confinement
summary: Within the known landscape of quantum gravity, most theories satisfy the Lattice Weak Gravity Conjecture (LWGC), which requires a superextremal particle at every site in the electric charge lattice $Γ$. However, counterexamples to the LWGC exist, and it was recently hypothesized that such counterexamples necessarily feature fractionally charged confined monopoles. In this work, we verify this hypothesis in toroidal orbifold compactifications of the heterotic string, which notably feature LWGC violation in both the abelian and nonabelian gauge sectors.
